data.gender_notes: Nimai is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Nimai is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Nimitta'. It means 'one who is a learned scholar or a wise man'. It is a name of Lord Krishna, who is known as 'Nimai' or 'Nimaiya', signifying his divine wisdom and knowledge. The name Nimai carries the meaning “Learned, Scholar” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Bengali. Parents who choose Nimai usually hope their child will grow to embody learned, scholar and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents spiritual growth, wisdom, and intelligence. It is believed that the bearer of this name is blessed with the qualities of a wise and learned man, who can guide others on their spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Nimai belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Learned, Scholar.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nimai total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
